name: Orca LLM Router
description: A self-contained local LLM gateway for Orca agents: direct provider connections (Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, …), conditional routing rules with rewrites, fallback chains, credential pools, a request log and usage dashboard.

settings.title: Route agent traffic
settings.description: When on, every enabled agent Orca launches is pointed at the sidecar. Turn individual agents off in the Agents tab.

settings.title: Sidecar port
settings.description: Local port the gateway listens on. 18080 by default.

settings.title: Sidecar host
settings.description: Bind address. Keep 127.0.0.1 unless other machines must reach the gateway.

settings.title: Upstream timeout (ms)
settings.description: Per-request ceiling for one upstream attempt, including long streams. 600000 keeps 10-minute streams alive.

settings.title: Retries per upstream
settings.description: Retries after 429, 5xx and network errors before falling over to the next model in the chain.

settings.title: Retry backoff base (ms)
settings.description: Exponential backoff starts at this delay; a positive Retry-After wins.
